detail.longDescription:
Quick Clean Plus is a phone cleaning tool that integrates multiple practical functions. It's designed to help you quickly perform daily phone cleaning and management tasks.

Core Functions:

🗑️Junk File Cleaning

Scans and cleans junk files within apps.

📱Background App Management

Displays currently running apps in the background, helping you close unnecessary programs.

🔋Battery Information View

Clearly displays battery status, including current battery level, temperature, battery type, and battery capacity.

📷Image Compression

When compressing photos, we will try our best to maintain the image clarity.

🔔Notification Clearing

Clears redundant and old notifications accumulated in the status bar.

🔊Speaker Cleaning

Vibration can be used to try to shake out dust from the speaker, but the actual effect varies depending on the environment in which the equipment is used and the nature of the dust.

🤝 Our Commitment:

Practical Functionality: Focused on achieving the core cleaning and management tasks you need.

Transparent Operation: Confirmation is required before performing important operations.

If you're looking for a practical and realistic phone cleaning and management tool, Quick Clean Plus is the right choice for you.
